papers.contribution: Declared workload corpus and synthetic generator semantics; independent reproduction and proxy-metric audit.
papers.experiments: 21 snapshots: 12 target, 8 minimum useful, 1 failed; four degraded Wi-Fi names remain connected. Seeds 1–30, four classes, 48 steps/class. Completion 0.427257, CI [0.411720,0.442795]; useful time 0.591493, CI [0.576466,0.606520]. Focused 27 tests pass; recovered reproduction stage 17 checks pass.
papers.findings: Offline workload coverage preserves declared service; unsupported wearable coding fails. No degraded state is exercised. Class ordering follows priors, duplicate metrics add no independent validation, recovery count is outage entries.
papers.limitations: No executed fair controller contest, real workload completion, calibrated device thresholds or physical twin. Corpus upstream Git source absent; content and file digests retained. Analytic expectations are post hoc.

papers.contribution: Preserved negative hypothesis, switch-charge decomposition and source-level baseline/ablation audit.
papers.experiments: Each vintage has train seeds 0–4 and heldout 100–104, 24 episodes x16 slots per seed. Historical complete non-timing outputs reproduced with SciPy SLSQP; fresh heldout parity retained. Original 5 and revised 31 historical tests pass; current focused 31 tests pass. Paired twin-minus-cloud mean -0.01359863, CI [-0.01477592,-0.01242134].
papers.findings: Procedural twin underperforms cloud fallback on heldout utility. Linear selector exceeds twin by 0.0343692; linear versus greedy comparison inconclusive. Other families vary; revised adaptive fidelity/checkpoint outcomes remain unfavorable.
papers.limitations: Five seed means; no equal computational budget or feature-use guarantee, unavailable static actions can score, oracle is greedy, some ablations modify scoring truth. Energy/radio metrics uncalibrated; cost crossing at lambda .33766 is retrospective fixed-trace algebra.

papers.contribution: Service-qualification counterexample, policy-equivalence characterization and shared-power expectation ceiling, reproduced in a synthetic benchmark.
papers.experiments: Seeds 1–30 x48 abstract steps. Exact fresh numerical-payload parity; source snapshot hashes verified. Full 37 tests pass, focused 9 pass. TN mean .73750333, NTN-aware .82916333; paired gain .09166, SD .04258833, CI [.07575726,.10756274], dz 2.15223274. Independent enumeration checks all eight P/R/V states for four qualification cases.
papers.findings: Qualifying LEO backup helps; all three NTN-aware policies have identical primary seed outcomes. Configured 550ms GEO or .5Mbps capacity makes satellite-first service .1083 while fallback/adaptive retain .7375. Shared power bounds expected service by .85.
papers.limitations: Bernoulli priors, capacity/delay constants and threshold uncalibrated; no congestion, switch penalty, orbital dynamics, physical satellite/RF/carrier/device evidence or seeded local/peer recovery. Close disaster simulators limit novelty; elementary analysis may not meet journal originality.
